x86_vaddps_zmm.summary: Add Packed Single-Precision Floating-Point Values (512-bit ZMM)
x86_vaddps_zmm.description: Performs SIMD element-wise addition of 16 single-precision (32-bit) IEEE 754 floating-point values from source register zmm2 and source operand zmm3/m512 (with optional broadcast of a single float32 to all 16 lanes). Stores the result in destination register zmm1 under the control of opmask register k1, supporting optional zero-masking {z}.
x86_vaddps_zmm.affected_flags: None (Floating-point exceptions captured in MXCSR register)
x86_vaddps_zmm.source_db: Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Reference

x86_mov_r64_imm64.description: Loads a full 64-bit immediate constant directly into the destination 64-bit general-purpose register. This is the only x86 MOV variant that accepts an unconstrained 64-bit immediate value without sign-extension.
x86_mov_r64_imm64.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

x86_cmpxchg_m64_r64.description: Compares the 64-bit value in the RAX accumulator with the destination operand in memory (m64). If equal, the source register (r64) is loaded into destination and ZF is set to 1. If not equal, the destination memory value is loaded into RAX and ZF is cleared to 0. When prepended with the LOCK prefix, executes atomically across cache lines.
x86_cmpxchg_m64_r64.affected_flags: ZF=1 if equal, ZF=0 if not equal; CF, OF, SF, AF, PF updated
x86_cmpxchg_m64_r64.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

x86_syscall.description: Transitions execution from user space (Ring 3) to kernel space (Ring 0) at the entry point specified in the IA32_LSTAR MSR. Saves RIP into RCX and RFLAGS into R11, while masking RFLAGS using the IA32_FMASK MSR.
x86_syscall.affected_flags: RFLAGS masked by IA32_FMASK MSR; original RFLAGS saved into R11
x86_syscall.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

x86_cpuid.operands: None (Implicit: EAX, ECX -> EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX)
x86_cpuid.description: Returns processor identification, vendor string, feature flags, cache topology, and extended architectural state support in EAX, EBX, ECX, and EDX based on the input leaf value in EAX and sub-leaf in ECX. Also acts as a serializing instruction.
x86_cpuid.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

x86_tdpbf16ps.summary: Matrix Multiply BFloat16 Tiles Accumulate to FP32
x86_tdpbf16ps.description: Performs a matrix dot-product multiply of pairs of bfloat16 values from 2D tile registers tmm2 and tmm3, accumulating the single-precision (FP32) floating-point results into tile tmm1.
x86_tdpbf16ps.vector_length: Tile 2D Matrix (up to 1024 bytes per tile)
x86_tdpbf16ps.source_db: Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Reference

x86_sal_r64_imm8.summary: Shift Arithmetic Left 64-Bit Register by Immediate Count
x86_sal_r64_imm8.description: Shifts destination 64-bit register bits to the left by the count specified in imm8, inserting zeros at the least-significant bit (LSB) and shifting the highest bit into Carry Flag (CF). Note: In x86/AMD64 hardware encoding, SAL and SHL share the exact same machine code opcode (C1 /4) because an arithmetic left shift and a logical left shift perform the identical bitwise operation.
x86_sal_r64_imm8.affected_flags: CF, OF, SF, ZF, PF updated, AF undefined
x86_sal_r64_imm8.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

x86_sal_r32_cl.summary: Shift Arithmetic Left 32-Bit Register by CL Register Count
x86_sal_r32_cl.description: Shifts destination 32-bit register left by the count in the CL register (count masked to 5 bits: 0-31), inserting zeros at LSB and copying out bits into CF. Functionally and binary identical to SHL r32, cl.
x86_sal_r32_cl.affected_flags: CF, OF, SF, ZF, PF updated, AF undefined
x86_sal_r32_cl.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

x86_sal_m32_1.summary: Shift Arithmetic Left 32-Bit Memory Location by 1
x86_sal_m32_1.description: Shifts the 32-bit memory location left by 1 bit, multiplying the value by 2. Sets OF if the top two bits of the original value differed (indicating arithmetic overflow).
x86_sal_m32_1.affected_flags: CF, OF, SF, ZF, PF updated, AF undefined
x86_sal_m32_1.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

arm64_fadd_vec.description: Adds corresponding 32-bit single-precision IEEE 754 floating-point elements in the four vector lanes of registers v1 and v2, writing the four resulting 32-bit sums into vector destination register v0.
arm64_fadd_vec.affected_flags: None (Cumulative FP exceptions recorded in FPSR)

arm64_ldp_post.description: Loads two 64-bit doublewords from consecutive memory locations starting at base address in Xn into destination registers Xt1 and Xt2, then updates base address register Xn by adding the signed immediate byte offset.

arm64_cas_64.description: Compares 64-bit value in register Xs with the 64-bit value in memory at address [Xn]. If equal, writes 64-bit value from Xt into memory. In all cases, loads the original value from memory into Xs.

arm64_pacia.summary: Pointer Authentication Code (Key A, Data Modifier)
arm64_pacia.description: Calculates and inserts a cryptographic Pointer Authentication Code (PAC) into the unused upper bits of the 64-bit pointer in Xd, using Key A and the modifier value in Xn.

arm64_bti.description: Serves as an authorized landing pad for indirect branches. If an indirect branch targets an instruction other than a valid BTI (or PACIASP/PACIBASP), a Branch Target Exception is raised.

armv7_add_r.description: Adds the 32-bit value in register r2 to r1, placing the sum in destination register r0. If conditional execution codes (e.g. ADDEQ, ADDNE) are specified, the instruction executes only if APSR flags satisfy condition.
armv7_add_r.affected_flags: APSR (N, Z, C, V updated if S suffix specified)

armv7_vadd_f32.description: Performs parallel SIMD addition of four single-precision 32-bit floating-point elements from 128-bit source registers q1 and q2, placing the four sums into 128-bit destination register q0.

rv_vadd_vv.description: Performs element-wise addition of active elements in vector register group vs2 and vs1 under mask vm, writing elements to destination vector vd according to current SEW (Selected Element Width) and LMUL (Vector Register Multiplier).

rv_jalr.summary: Jump and Link Register (Indirect Control Transfer)
rv_jalr.description: Sets the program counter (PC) to (rs1 + sign-extended 12-bit offset) with the least-significant bit forced to zero. Simultaneously stores the return address (PC + 4) into destination register rd (commonly ra / x1).

rv_lr_w.description: Loads a 32-bit word from memory address in rs1 into destination register rd and registers a reservation on the memory address. Used in pair with SC.W (Store-Conditional) to implement lock-free atomic read-modify-write sequences.

rv_sc_w.description: Conditionally writes the 32-bit word in rs2 to memory address in rs1 if a valid reservation from a prior LR.W exists on the address. Writes 0 to destination register rd on success, or non-zero on failure.

rv_c_addi.description: Adds non-zero sign-extended 6-bit immediate to value in register rd and writes result back to rd. Provides a dense 16-bit encoding for the common `addi rd, rd, imm` instruction.

rv_vsetvli.summary: Set Vector Configuration (SEW, LMUL) and Vector Length
rv_vsetvli.description: Configures the vector unit with the requested element width (SEW), vector multiplier (LMUL), tail/mask agnostic policies (vta, vma) from vtypei, and sets the active vector length (vl) based on application vector length (AVL) in rs1. Writes the resulting granted vl into destination register rd.

add.description: Adds source operand to destination operand and stores result in destination register. Updates standard arithmetic status flags (CF, OF, SF, ZF, AF, PF) if architecture supports condition codes.

addi.description: Adds sign-extended immediate constant to source register and writes result to destination register.

addw.description: Adds lower 32 bits of source operands and sign-extends the 32-bit result to 64 bits.

addiw.description: Adds sign-extended 12-bit immediate to lower 32 bits of source register and sign-extends the 32-bit result to 64 bits.

sub.description: Subtracts source operand from destination operand (dest - src) and stores result in destination register. Evaluates borrow and overflow status.

subw.description: Subtracts lower 32 bits of source operands and sign-extends the 32-bit difference to 64 bits.

adc.description: Adds source operand and current Carry flag (CF) value to destination operand, storing sum in destination. Used for multi-word / multiprecision arithmetic chaining.

adcs.description: Adds source operand, destination operand, and Carry flag, placing result in destination and updating condition flags in PSTATE/APSR.

adds.description: Adds source operand to destination operand, writing result to destination and updating condition flags (N, Z, C, V) in PSTATE/APSR.

sbb.description: Subtracts source operand and current Carry/Borrow flag value from destination operand (dest - src - CF), storing difference in destination.

subs.description: Subtracts source operand from destination operand, writing result to destination and updating condition flags (N, Z, C, V).

mul.description: Performs integer multiplication of operands, producing product in destination register or register pair.

mulw.description: Multiplies lower 32 bits of source operands and sign-extends the 32-bit product to 64 bits.

mulh.description: Multiplies signed integers in source registers and returns the upper half of the 2*XLEN product.

mulhu.description: Multiplies unsigned integers in source registers and returns the upper half of the 2*XLEN product.

mulhsu.description: Multiplies signed integer in rs1 by unsigned integer in rs2 and returns the upper half of the product.

mulx.description: Multiplies unsigned operand by RDX/EDX without modifying arithmetic status flags, writing low half to dest1 and high half to dest2.

imul.description: Performs two's-complement signed integer multiplication, preserving sign across destination register or multi-register product.

div.description: Divides accumulator / dividend by source divisor operand, producing unsigned quotient.

divu.description: Divides unsigned value in rs1 by unsigned value in rs2, writing quotient to rd.

divw.description: Divides signed 32-bit integer in rs1 by signed 32-bit integer in rs2, sign-extending quotient to 64 bits.

divuw.description: Divides unsigned 32-bit integer in rs1 by unsigned 32-bit integer in rs2, sign-extending quotient to 64 bits.

idiv.description: Divides sign-extended dividend by divisor operand, computing signed quotient and signed remainder.

rem.description: Computes remainder of signed integer division (rs1 mod rs2), matching sign of dividend.

remu.description: Computes remainder of unsigned integer division (rs1 mod rs2).

remw.description: Computes signed 32-bit remainder and sign-extends result to 64 bits.

remuw.description: Computes unsigned 32-bit remainder and sign-extends result to 64 bits.

neg.description: Replaces operand value with its two's-complement arithmetic negation (0 - operand). Sets Carry Flag (CF) to 1 unless operand is 0.

negs.description: Computes (0 - operand), writing result to destination and updating condition flags (N, Z, C, V).

inc.description: Adds 1 to destination operand without modifying the Carry Flag (CF), preserving CF for loop counters.

dec.description: Subtracts 1 from destination operand without modifying the Carry Flag (CF).

cmn.description: Adds two operands and updates condition flags (N, Z, C, V) without saving result, testing if operand equals -operand.

cmp.description: Compares first operand with second operand by performing non-destructive subtraction (op1 - op2), updating condition flags based on difference.

ccmp.description: Conditionally compares two operands if prior condition flags hold; otherwise sets condition flags to an immediate value without performing subtraction.

ccmn.description: Conditionally performs addition comparison if prior condition flags hold; otherwise sets condition flags to immediate.

slt.description: Writes 1 to destination register if signed value in rs1 < signed value in rs2; otherwise writes 0.

slti.description: Writes 1 to destination register if signed value in rs1 < sign-extended immediate; otherwise writes 0.

sltu.description: Writes 1 to destination register if unsigned value in rs1 < unsigned value in rs2; otherwise writes 0.

sltiu.description: Writes 1 to destination register if unsigned value in rs1 < unsigned immediate; otherwise writes 0.

and.description: Computes bitwise logical AND of source and destination operands. Bit is 1 if and only if both input bits are 1.

andi.description: Computes bitwise AND between source register and sign-extended immediate constant.

ands.description: Computes bitwise logical AND, storing result in destination and updating Zero (Z) and Negative (N) flags.

or.description: Computes bitwise logical inclusive OR of source and destination operands. Bit is 1 if either input bit is 1.

ori.description: Computes bitwise inclusive OR between source register and sign-extended immediate constant.

orr.description: Performs bitwise inclusive OR between source registers/immediates, storing result in destination.

orrs.description: Performs bitwise OR and updates condition flags in PSTATE.

xor.description: Computes bitwise logical XOR of source and destination operands. Zeroes register when applied to identical registers (`xor eax, eax`).

xori.description: Computes bitwise XOR between source register and sign-extended immediate constant.

eor.description: Performs bitwise XOR between operands and stores result in destination register.

eors.description: Performs bitwise XOR, updating condition flags.

not.description: Inverts all bits of the operand, replacing 0s with 1s and 1s with 0s without altering condition flags.

mvn.description: Performs bitwise NOT on source operand and writes inverted value to destination register.

mvns.description: Performs bitwise NOT on source operand, storing inverted value in destination and updating condition flags.

bic.description: Performs bitwise AND of destination operand with bitwise inverse of source operand (`dest AND (NOT src)`), clearing specified bits.

bics.description: Performs `dest AND (NOT src)` and updates condition flags.

orn.description: Computes `dest OR (NOT src)` bitwise logical operation.

andn.description: Computes `dest AND (NOT src)` bitwise logical operation.

xnor.description: Computes bitwise `NOT (src1 XOR src2)`, setting bit to 1 where corresponding bits match.

shl.description: Shifts operand bits left by count, inserting zeros at LSB. High-order bits are shifted into Carry Flag.

sal.description: Shifts destination operand bits to the left by the count specified in immediate or CL register, shifting in zeros at the least-significant bit (LSB) and copying high-order bits into Carry Flag (CF). In x86/AMD64 hardware encoding, SAL and SHL share the exact same machine code opcodes (D0/D1/C0/C1/D2/D3 /4) because an arithmetic left shift and a logical left shift perform the identical bitwise operation.

shr.description: Shifts operand bits right by count, inserting zeros at MSB. Low-order bits are shifted into Carry Flag.

sar.description: Shifts operand bits right by count while replicating sign bit at MSB, performing signed integer division by powers of 2.

sll.description: Shifts value in rs1 left by shift amount in rs2, writing shifted result to rd.

slli.description: Shifts value in rs1 left by immediate shift count.

srl.description: Shifts value in rs1 right by shift amount in rs2, inserting zeros at MSB.

srli.description: Shifts value in rs1 right by immediate shift count.

sra.description: Shifts value in rs1 right by shift amount in rs2, replicating sign bit.

srai.description: Shifts value in rs1 right by immediate shift count, replicating sign bit.

lsl.description: Shifts register bits left by specified immediate or register amount, inserting zeros at LSB.

lsr.description: Shifts register bits right by specified immediate or register amount, inserting zeros at MSB.

asr.description: Shifts register bits right while replicating sign bit, maintaining two's-complement sign.

ror.description: Rotates bits right circularly; bits shifted out of LSB wrap around into MSB and copy into Carry Flag.

rol.description: Rotates bits left circularly; bits shifted out of MSB wrap around into LSB and copy into Carry Flag.

rorx.description: Rotates 32-bit or 64-bit register right by immediate count without reading or modifying condition flags.

shlx.description: Performs logical left shift using BMI2 without reading or modifying condition flags.

shrx.description: Performs logical right shift using BMI2 without reading or modifying condition flags.

sarx.summary: Shift Arithmetic Right Without Affecting Flags
sarx.description: Performs arithmetic right shift using BMI2 without reading or modifying condition flags.

bextr.description: Extracts contiguous bit sequence from source operand using start index and length specified in control register/immediate.

blsi.description: Clears all bits in source operand except the lowest set bit (`src AND (-src)`). Sets ZF=1 if source is zero.

blsmsk.summary: Get Mask Up to Lowest Set Bit
blsmsk.description: Sets all bits from bit 0 up to lowest set bit in source operand (`src XOR (src - 1)`).

blsr.description: Clears the lowest set bit in source operand (`src AND (src - 1)`).

bzhi.summary: Zero High Bits Starting from Specified Bit
bzhi.description: Zeroes all bits of source operand at and above the specified bit index position.

pdep.description: Deposits contiguous low bits from source operand into positions specified by mask operand bits.

pext.description: Extracts bits from source operand specified by mask operand into contiguous low bits of destination.

popcnt.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in source operand and stores the count in destination register.

lzcnt.description: Counts the number of continuous zero bits starting from MSB down to first set bit.

tzcnt.description: Counts the number of continuous zero bits starting from LSB up to first set bit.

clz.description: Counts consecutive zero bits from MSB of source operand and writes count to destination register.

ctz.description: Counts consecutive zero bits from LSB of source operand and writes count to destination register.

cpop.description: Counts the number of set bits (Hamming weight) in register and writes count to destination.

cls.description: Counts consecutive bits following MSB that match the sign bit value.

rbit.description: Reverses the bit order of 32-bit or 64-bit register (bit 0 becomes bit 31/63).

rev.description: Reverses byte endianness within 32-bit or 64-bit register.

rev16.description: Reverses byte order within each 16-bit halfword lane independently.

rev32.description: Reverses byte order within each 32-bit word lane of a 64-bit register.

rev8.description: Reverses the byte order in register rs1, performing endianness conversion.

bswap.description: Reverses byte order in 32-bit or 64-bit general-purpose register.

sbfx.description: Extracts signed contiguous bitfield from register and sign-extends to register width.

ubfx.description: Extracts unsigned contiguous bitfield from register and zero-extends to register width.

bfi.description: Copies contiguous bitfield from source register into specified bit position of destination register.

bfxil.summary: Bit Field Extract and Insert Low
bfxil.description: Extracts contiguous bitfield from source register and inserts into low bits of destination register.

extr.description: Concatenates two registers into double-width value, extracts bitfield at specified byte/bit offset, and writes to destination.

bt.description: Selects bit at specified offset from bit base and copies value into Carry Flag (CF).

bts.description: Copies selected bit into Carry Flag (CF) and sets the bit in destination operand to 1.

btr.description: Copies selected bit into Carry Flag (CF) and clears the bit in destination operand to 0.

btc.description: Copies selected bit into Carry Flag (CF) and inverts the bit in destination operand.

clmul.description: Performs polynomial carry-less multiplication over GF(2) and writes lower half of 2*XLEN product to destination.

clmulh.description: Performs polynomial carry-less multiplication and writes upper half of product to destination.

clmulr.description: Performs reversed polynomial carry-less multiplication for CRC acceleration.

sh1add.description: Shifts value in rs1 left by 1 and adds value in rs2 (`(rs1 << 1) + rs2`), optimizing 2-byte array indexing.

sh2add.description: Shifts value in rs1 left by 2 and adds value in rs2 (`(rs1 << 2) + rs2`), optimizing 4-byte pointer indexing.

sh3add.description: Shifts value in rs1 left by 3 and adds value in rs2 (`(rs1 << 3) + rs2`), optimizing 8-byte pointer indexing.

bclr.description: Clears the single bit at index specified by rs2 in register rs1.

bset.description: Sets the single bit at index specified by rs2 in register rs1.

binv.description: Inverts (flips) the single bit at index specified by rs2 in register rs1.

bext.description: Extracts the single bit at index specified by rs2 in register rs1 and writes 0 or 1 to rd.

csel.description: Selects first source register if condition holds; otherwise selects second source register.

csinc.description: Selects first source register if condition holds; otherwise selects second source register incremented by 1.

csinv.description: Selects first source register if condition holds; otherwise selects bitwise inverse of second source register.

csneg.description: Selects first source register if condition holds; otherwise selects arithmetic negation of second source register.

cset.description: Sets destination register to 1 if condition is true; otherwise sets to 0.

csetm.description: Sets destination register to all 1s (0xFFFFFFFF / 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) if condition is true; otherwise sets to 0.

cinc.description: Increments source register by 1 if condition is true; otherwise copies source register unchanged.

cinv.description: Inverts source register bitwise if condition is true; otherwise copies source register unchanged.

cneg.description: Negates source register if condition is true; otherwise copies source register unchanged.

cmove.description: Copies source operand to destination register only if Zero Flag ZF=1.

cmovne.description: Copies source operand to destination register only if Zero Flag ZF=0.

cmovb.description: Copies source operand to destination register only if Carry Flag CF=1 (unsigned below).

cmova.summary: Conditional Move if Above (CF=0 and ZF=0)
cmova.description: Copies source operand to destination register only if above (unsigned).

cmovl.description: Copies source operand to destination register only if signed less than.

cmovg.summary: Conditional Move if Greater (ZF=0 and SF=OF)
cmovg.description: Copies source operand to destination register only if signed greater than.

sete.description: Sets destination 8-bit register/memory to 1 if ZF=1; otherwise sets to 0.

setne.description: Sets destination 8-bit register/memory to 1 if ZF=0; otherwise sets to 0.

setb.description: Sets destination 8-bit register/memory to 1 if CF=1; otherwise sets to 0.

seta.summary: Set Byte if Above (CF=0 and ZF=0)
seta.description: Sets destination 8-bit register/memory to 1 if above; otherwise sets to 0.

setl.description: Sets destination 8-bit register/memory to 1 if SF != OF; otherwise sets to 0.

setg.description: Sets destination 8-bit register/memory to 1 if ZF=0 and SF==OF; otherwise sets to 0.

mov.description: Copies data from source operand to destination operand without modifying condition flags.

movsx.description: Copies smaller integer from source into larger destination register, extending the sign bit across upper bits.

movsxd.summary: Move Doubleword to Quadword with Sign-Extension
movsxd.description: Sign-extends 32-bit source register/memory to 64-bit destination register.

movzx.description: Copies smaller unsigned integer from source into larger destination register, clearing upper bits to zero.

lea.description: Computes effective memory address from addressing expression (base + index * scale + disp) and stores address in destination register without reading memory.

ldr.description: Loads data from memory at calculated target address into destination register.

ldrb.description: Loads 8-bit byte from memory and zero-extends to register width.

ldrh.description: Loads 16-bit halfword from memory and zero-extends to register width.

ldrsb.description: Loads 8-bit byte from memory and sign-extends to register width.

ldrsh.description: Loads 16-bit halfword from memory and sign-extends to register width.

ldrsw.description: Loads 32-bit word from memory and sign-extends to 64-bit register.

str.description: Stores register value into memory at calculated target address.

strb.description: Stores lowest 8 bits of register to memory address.

strh.description: Stores lowest 16 bits of register to memory address.

ldp.description: Loads two consecutive registers from adjacent memory addresses in a single memory access.

stp.description: Stores two consecutive registers to adjacent memory addresses in a single memory access.

push.description: Decrements stack pointer by operand size and copies value onto top of stack.

pop.description: Loads value from top of stack into destination register and increments stack pointer.

lw.description: Loads sign-extended 32-bit word from memory address into destination register.

sw.description: Stores low 32 bits of source register into memory address.

ld.description: Loads full 64-bit doubleword from memory address into destination register.

sd.description: Stores full 64-bit value from source register into memory address.

lh.description: Loads 16-bit halfword from memory and sign-extends to XLEN bits.

lhu.description: Loads 16-bit halfword from memory and zero-extends to XLEN bits.

sh.description: Stores low 16 bits of source register into memory address.

lb.description: Loads 8-bit byte from memory and sign-extends to XLEN bits.

lbu.description: Loads 8-bit byte from memory and zero-extends to XLEN bits.

sb.description: Stores low 8 bits of source register into memory address.

lui.description: Loads 20-bit immediate into upper 20 bits of destination register, clearing low 12 bits to zero.

auipc.description: Adds 20-bit upper immediate to PC, placing result in destination register (used for PC-relative address formation).

jmp.description: Transfers program execution control unconditionally to target address specified by label, register, or memory offset.

call.description: Pushes return address onto stack and branches to target procedure entry point.

ret.description: Pops return address from stack into instruction pointer, resuming execution in caller procedure.

b.description: Transfers execution to target label or PC-relative offset. Evaluates condition code if suffix present.

bl.description: Writes return address (PC + 4) into Link Register (LR/X30) and branches to target subroutine.

blr.description: Writes return address to Link Register and jumps to dynamic address in register.

bx.description: Branches to target address in register and switches between ARM and Thumb instruction states according to bit 0.

blx.description: Stores return address in Link Register, branches to target address, and switches execution state.

cbz.description: Tests if source register equals zero, branching to target offset if zero without modifying condition flags.

cbnz.description: Tests if source register is non-zero, branching to target offset if not zero without modifying condition flags.

tbz.summary: Test Bit and Branch on Zero
tbz.description: Tests bit at specified position in register, branching to target address if bit is 0.

tbnz.summary: Test Bit and Branch on Non-Zero
tbnz.description: Tests bit at specified position in register, branching to target address if bit is 1.

jal.description: Adds sign-extended 20-bit offset to PC for jump target, writing return address (PC + 4) to destination register rd (default ra/x1).

jalr.description: Sets PC to `(rs1 + offset) & ~1`, writing return address (PC + 4) into destination register rd.

beq.description: Branches to PC-relative offset if rs1 == rs2.

bne.description: Branches to PC-relative offset if rs1 != rs2.

blt.description: Branches to PC-relative offset if rs1 < rs2 (signed comparison).

bge.summary: Branch if Greater Than or Equal (Signed)
bge.description: Branches to PC-relative offset if rs1 >= rs2 (signed comparison).

bltu.description: Branches to PC-relative offset if rs1 < rs2 (unsigned comparison).

bgeu.summary: Branch if Greater Than or Equal (Unsigned)
bgeu.description: Branches to PC-relative offset if rs1 >= rs2 (unsigned comparison).

loop.description: Decrements count register (RCX/ECX/CX) and branches to target if count != 0.

cmpxchg.description: Compares value in accumulator with destination operand; if equal, writes source to destination (ZF=1); otherwise loads destination to accumulator (ZF=0).

xchg.description: Exchanges contents of register and memory/register atomically with implicit bus lock on memory operands.

xadd.description: Exchanges first operand with second operand, loading their sum into first operand (atomic fetch-and-add with LOCK).

cas.description: Compares value in register with memory location; if equal, stores new value to memory; returns original memory value.

swp.description: Atomically reads memory location into destination register and writes new value from source register to memory.

ldxr.description: Loads value from memory and registers an exclusive access monitor on the address.

stxr.description: Conditionally stores value to memory if exclusive monitor is held; returns 0 on success or 1 on failure.

ldaxr.description: Loads value from memory with acquire memory ordering semantics and sets exclusive monitor.

stlxr.description: Stores value to memory with release memory ordering semantics if exclusive monitor is valid.

ldadd.description: Atomically loads value from memory, adds register value, and stores sum back to memory.

ldclr.description: Atomically loads value from memory, clears bits specified by register mask, and stores result.

ldset.description: Atomically loads value from memory, sets bits specified by register mask, and stores result.

ldeor.description: Atomically loads value from memory, XORs with register, and stores result.

ldsmax.description: Atomically updates memory location with maximum of signed memory value and register value.

ldsmin.description: Atomically updates memory location with minimum of signed memory value and register value.

ldumax.description: Atomically updates memory location with maximum of unsigned memory value and register value.

ldumin.description: Atomically updates memory location with minimum of unsigned memory value and register value.

lr.w.description: Loads 32-bit word from memory and places reservation on address for subsequent SC.W.

sc.w.description: Conditionally writes 32-bit word to memory if reservation is valid; returns 0 on success.

lr.d.description: Loads 64-bit doubleword from memory and registers reservation.

sc.d.description: Conditionally writes 64-bit doubleword to memory if reservation is valid.

amoadd.w.description: Atomically loads 32-bit word from memory, adds source register, and writes sum to memory.

amoswap.w.description: Atomically exchanges 32-bit word in memory with source register.

amoxor.w.description: Atomically XORs 32-bit word in memory with source register.

amoand.w.description: Atomically ANDs 32-bit word in memory with source register.

amoor.w.description: Atomically ORs 32-bit word in memory with source register.

amomin.w.description: Atomically updates 32-bit word in memory with minimum of memory value and register.

amomax.w.description: Atomically updates 32-bit word in memory with maximum of memory value and register.

amominu.w.description: Atomically updates memory with minimum of unsigned memory value and register.

amomaxu.w.description: Atomically updates memory with maximum of unsigned memory value and register.

fence.description: Enforces strict memory and I/O access ordering between preceding and succeeding instructions.

fence.i.description: Synchronizes instruction cache pipeline with data memory writes for self-modifying / JIT code.

dmb.description: Ensures explicit memory accesses before barrier are observed by all cores before memory accesses after barrier.

dsb.description: Completes all prior memory and cache/TLB operations before any subsequent instruction can execute.

isb.description: Flushes CPU instruction pipeline and refetches subsequent instructions from cache or memory.

sfence.description: Serializes all memory write (store) operations issued prior to the SFENCE instruction.

lfence.description: Serializes all memory read (load) operations issued prior to LFENCE and prevents speculative execution.

mfence.description: Serializes all load and store memory operations, ensuring global memory visibility.

fadd.description: Performs IEEE 754 floating-point addition across scalar or SIMD vector lanes with dynamic rounding.

fsub.description: Performs IEEE 754 floating-point subtraction across scalar or SIMD vector lanes.

fmul.description: Performs IEEE 754 floating-point multiplication across scalar or SIMD vector lanes.

fdiv.description: Performs IEEE 754 floating-point division across scalar or SIMD vector lanes.

fsqrt.description: Computes IEEE 754 square root of floating-point operand.

fmadd.description: Computes `(src1 * src2) + src3` with a single final rounding step for maximal accuracy.

fmsub.description: Computes `(src1 * src2) - src3` with a single final rounding step.

fnmadd.description: Computes `-((src1 * src2) + src3)` with a single final rounding step.

fnmsub.description: Computes `-((src1 * src2) - src3)` with a single final rounding step.

fmax.description: Returns larger of two floating-point values according to IEEE 754 rules.

fmin.description: Returns smaller of two floating-point values according to IEEE 754 rules.

fmaxnm.description: Returns numerical maximum, ignoring NaN unless both inputs are NaN.

fminnm.description: Returns numerical minimum, ignoring NaN unless both inputs are NaN.

vaddps.description: Performs SIMD element-wise addition of 32-bit floats across 128-bit (4), 256-bit (8), or 512-bit (16) vector lanes.

vaddpd.description: Performs SIMD element-wise addition of 64-bit floats across 128-bit (2), 256-bit (4), or 512-bit (8) vector lanes.

vmulps.description: Performs SIMD element-wise multiplication of 32-bit floats across vector lanes.

vmulpd.description: Performs SIMD element-wise multiplication of 64-bit floats across vector lanes.

vsubps.description: Performs SIMD element-wise subtraction of 32-bit floats across vector lanes.

vsubpd.description: Performs SIMD element-wise subtraction of 64-bit floats across vector lanes.

vdivps.description: Performs SIMD element-wise division of 32-bit floats across vector lanes.

vdivpd.description: Performs SIMD element-wise division of 64-bit floats across vector lanes.

vsqrtps.summary: Square Root of Packed Single-Precision Floats
vsqrtps.description: Computes SIMD square root of 32-bit floating-point values across vector lanes.

vsqrtpd.summary: Square Root of Packed Double-Precision Floats
vsqrtpd.description: Computes SIMD square root of 64-bit floating-point values across vector lanes.

vfmadd132ps.description: Computes `dest = (dest * src3) + src2` with single final rounding step.

vfmadd213ps.description: Computes `dest = (dest * src2) + src3` with single final rounding step.

vfmadd231ps.description: Computes `dest = (src2 * src3) + dest` with single final rounding step.

vbroadcastss.description: Loads a single 32-bit float and replicates it across all lanes of destination vector register.

vbroadcastsd.description: Loads a single 64-bit float and replicates it across all lanes of destination vector register.

vpbroadcastb.description: Replicates an 8-bit integer across all byte lanes of destination vector register.

vpbroadcastw.description: Replicates a 16-bit integer across all word lanes of destination vector register.

vpbroadcastd.description: Replicates a 32-bit integer across all doubleword lanes of destination vector register.

vpbroadcastq.description: Replicates a 64-bit integer across all quadword lanes of destination vector register.

vzeroall.description: Zeroes all vector registers (YMM0-YMM15/ZMM0-ZMM31) and resets AVX state to avoid AVX-SSE transition penalties.

vzeroupper.summary: Zero Upper Bits of YMM/ZMM Registers
vzeroupper.description: Zeroes upper 128/384 bits of vector registers, transitioning from AVX/AVX-512 to legacy SSE state without penalty.

aesenc.description: Applies ShiftRows, SubBytes, MixColumns, and AddRoundKey transformations of AES using 128-bit round key.

aesdec.description: Applies Inverse ShiftRows, Inverse SubBytes, Inverse MixColumns, and AddRoundKey transformations of AES.

aesenclast.description: Applies ShiftRows, SubBytes, and AddRoundKey (omitting MixColumns) for final round of AES encryption.

aesdeclast.description: Applies Inverse ShiftRows, Inverse SubBytes, and AddRoundKey (omitting Inverse MixColumns) for final round of AES decryption.

aesimc.description: Applies Inverse MixColumns transformation to round key for equivalent decryption schedule.

aeskeygenassist.description: Generates round keys for AES-128, AES-192, and AES-256 key schedules using S-box substitutions and round constant.

sha256h.description: Performs SHA-256 hash computation round updates on 128-bit state.

sha256h2.description: Performs secondary SHA-256 hash round update step on state vector.

sha256su0.description: Computes intermediate message schedule step for SHA-256 algorithm.

sha256su1.description: Computes final message schedule step for SHA-256 algorithm.

syscall.description: Transfers control from user space (Ring 3) to kernel space (Ring 0) via MSR entry point.

sysret.description: Returns execution from kernel space (Ring 0) back to 64-bit user space (Ring 3).

svc.description: Raises supervisor exception, transitioning execution to OS kernel at EL1.

smc.description: Transitions execution to Secure Monitor at EL3.

hvc.description: Transitions execution to hypervisor at EL2.

ecall.description: Makes system call request to execution environment at current privilege mode.

ebreak.description: Raises breakpoint trap exception for software debuggers.

wfi.description: Suspends core execution and puts processor into low-power sleep mode until an interrupt occurs.

wfe.description: Suspends processor execution until a global event is signaled via SEV or an interrupt occurs.

sev.description: Broadcasts an event signal to all cores in system, waking cores executing WFE.

hlt.description: Stops instruction execution and enters halted state until an enabled interrupt occurs.

pause.description: Optimizes processor pipeline execution during spin-wait loops, saving power and avoiding memory penalties.

cpuid.description: Introspects processor hardware capabilities, CPUID leaves, cache topology, and vendor string.

rdtsc.description: Reads current 64-bit cycle count from hardware Time-Stamp Counter into EDX:EAX.

rdtscp.summary: Read Time-Stamp Counter and Processor ID
rdtscp.description: Reads 64-bit TSC into EDX:EAX and processor socket/core ID into ECX with serialization guarantees.

mrs.description: Transfers value from privileged system register / CSR into general-purpose register.

msr.description: Writes value from general-purpose register into privileged system register / CSR.

csrrw.description: Atomically reads previous value of CSR into destination register and writes new value from source register.

csrrs.summary: Atomic Read and Set Bits in CSR
csrrs.description: Atomically reads previous value of CSR and sets bits specified by bitmask in source register.

csrrc.summary: Atomic Read and Clear Bits in CSR
csrrc.description: Atomically reads previous value of CSR and clears bits specified by bitmask in source register.

csrrwi.description: Atomically writes 5-bit zero-extended immediate to CSR and returns previous CSR value.

csrrsi.description: Atomically sets bits in CSR using 5-bit zero-extended immediate bitmask.

csrrci.description: Atomically clears bits in CSR using 5-bit zero-extended immediate bitmask.

mret.description: Restores PC from mepc and restores privilege / interrupt state from mstatus.

sret.description: Restores PC from sepc and restores privilege / interrupt state from sstatus.

uret.description: Restores PC from uepc and restores user privilege state.
